The upper 4K wide-angle camera gives a 130° fixed view of the whole area, while the lower 2K dual-lens pan-tilt-zoom camera rotates 360° for all-round coverage.

When the bullet camera detects a person, the pan-tilt-zoom camera locks on and follows with a sharp, centered close-up from up to 50 meters. If other subjects enter the frame, it zooms out automatically so everyone stays visible.
A 5.5W solar panel with SolarPlus 2.0 keeps the camera running on just one hour of direct sunlight a day, even in cloudy weather, and the detachable design makes installation easy and flexible.
eufyCam S4 works without a HomeBase, using on-device AI to detect people, vehicles and pets. It includes 32GB of built-in storage, expandable to 256GB with a microSD card (not included).

Pair with HomeBase S380 to unlock BionicMind AI, which instantly tells family from strangers, plus 16GB of built-in storage expandable to 16TB. An existing S380 needs version V3.7.2.8 or later and the latest eufy app to enable 24/7 recording and Snapshot.
Radar and PIR sensors deliver accurate motion alerts with fewer false alarms. When a threat is detected inside your chosen zone or schedule, red and blue warning lights and a 105 dB siren activate.
